# Deep Research Intelligence Packet

## Cycle metadata

- Packet ID: `dr-20260922-1605-agilysys-validation`
- Research system: `Codex web research`
- Started at: `2026-09-22 16:05 CDT`
- Completed at: `2026-09-22 16:09 CDT`
- Research scope: Validate four first-party Agilysys customer/selection pages, emphasizing named food-and-beverage deployments and the unresolved restaurant-market category boundary.
- Queue item or vendor: `competitor:agilysys`
- Methodology: Candidate-page validation and first-party competitor/customer research

## Executive result

- Pages reviewed: 4
- Candidate pages validated: 4
- Brand-vendor-product observations added or revised: 4
- Conflicts found: 1 scope conflict
- Material takeaway: Agilysys has strong, named InfoGenesis POS evidence in complex foodservice environments, including a 16-stall food hall and resort/casino dining operations. Three of four pages are hotel/resort/casino embedded, however, and IHG's portfolio approval is an approved-option relationship rather than proof of portfolio-wide deployment. The evidence strengthens Agilysys's hospitality-F&B competitive profile but does not establish broad standalone restaurant-chain penetration.

## Evidence observations

### Observation 1

- Brand: Famous Foods Street Eats at Resorts World Las Vegas
- Vendor: Agilysys
- Product or category: InfoGenesis POS, 34 IG Kiosks, Agilysys Pay, Agilysys Analyze, and Agilysys KDS
- Relationship indication: customer
- Deployment scope: location-level
- Evidence type: press release / customer story
- Confidence: 95%
- Confidence rationale: Agilysys names the venue, an operator executive explains the selection, and the page gives deployed product and quantity detail.
- Source title: Famous Foods Street Eats in Resorts World Las Vegas Serves Up Modern, Innovative Guest Dining Through the Agilysys InfoGenesis Point-of-Sale (POS) Platform and Kiosks
- Source URL: https://www.agilysys.com/en/news/famous-foods-street-eats-in-resorts-world-las-vegas-serves-up-modern-innovative-guest-dining-through-the-agilysys-infogenesis-point-of-sale-pos-platform-and-kiosks/
- Publisher or source owner: Agilysys
- Published date, if known: 2024-10-07
- Accessed date: 2026-09-22
- Exact supporting excerpt or faithful factual note: Agilysys reports that the 24,000-square-foot food hall selected InfoGenesis and related solutions across 16 culinary stalls and deployed 34 kiosks, payments, analytics, and kitchen display capabilities.
- Product-specific evidence: Centralized menus and pricing; multi-stall order routing; kiosk ordering and payment; player-points, room-charge, payroll-deduction, and card tenders; KDS; P2PE payments; operating analytics.
- Conflicting or limiting evidence: This is one food-hall venue inside a casino resort, not a standalone chain or proof of enterprise-wide Resorts World deployment.
- Recommended follow-up: Seek an operator-controlled technology page or current procurement artifact confirming continued use after the 2024 implementation.

### Observation 2

- Brand: Winford Resort & Casino Manila
- Vendor: Agilysys
- Product or category: InfoGenesis POS with Total Rewards System integration
- Relationship indication: customer
- Deployment scope: location-level
- Evidence type: press release / testimonial
- Confidence: 95%
- Confidence rationale: The March 2026 vendor announcement states that deployment is complete across 11 venues and includes a named Winford IT executive testimonial.
- Source title: Winford Resort & Casino Manila Philippines deploys Agilysys Hospitality Technology to Elevate Operations and Service
- Source URL: https://www.agilysys.com/en/news/winford-resort-casino-manila-philippines-deploys-agilysys-hospitality-technology-to-elevate-operations-and-service/
- Publisher or source owner: Agilysys
- Published date, if known: 2026-03-04
- Accessed date: 2026-09-22
- Exact supporting excerpt or faithful factual note: Winford deployed InfoGenesis to centralize food-and-beverage operations across 11 venues and connect dining transactions to its rewards system in real time.
- Product-specific evidence: POS, automated dining workflows, real-time rewards earn/redemption, billing accuracy, reporting, mobility, and replacement of legacy POS.
- Conflicting or limiting evidence: Integrated-resort scope; it does not demonstrate adoption by a restaurant chain.
- Recommended follow-up: Look for Winford or Newport World Resorts source material and clarify whether Newport technology standards imply any broader related-property footprint.

### Observation 3

- Brand: Rudding Park
- Vendor: Agilysys
- Product or category: InfoGenesis POS, OnDemand, Reserve Dining & Pay, Agilysys Pay, and Analyze within a broader resort platform
- Relationship indication: customer
- Deployment scope: location-level / planned deployment
- Evidence type: press release
- Confidence: 90%
- Confidence rationale: The vendor names the selected suite and quotes Rudding Park's revenue and strategy director, but describes a transformation that will be deployed rather than a completed installed base.
- Source title: Rudding Park Selects Agilysys Hospitality Software Solutions to Modernise Guest Journeys and Streamline Operations Across its Hotel Ecosystem
- Source URL: https://www.agilysys.com/en/news/rudding-park-selects-agilysys-hospitality-software-solutions-to-modernise-guest-journeys-and-streamline-operations-across-its-hotel-ecosystem/
- Publisher or source owner: Agilysys
- Published date, if known: 2026-02-19
- Accessed date: 2026-09-22
- Exact supporting excerpt or faithful factual note: The 90-room resort with three restaurants selected a unified Agilysys platform including InfoGenesis, OnDemand, Reserve Dining & Pay, and Analyze.
- Product-specific evidence: Restaurant POS, mobile ordering, dining reservations and payments, payments, unified guest profile, and cross-property analytics.
- Conflicting or limiting evidence: Selection/planned-deployment status and hotel-resort scope; no claim of a completed restaurant rollout should be inferred.
- Recommended follow-up: Recheck for a go-live announcement or operator-authored implementation result.

### Observation 4

- Brand: IHG Hotels & Resorts
- Vendor: Agilysys
- Product or category: InfoGenesis POS ecosystem
- Relationship indication: approved provider / customer at select properties
- Deployment scope: enterprise option with select-property use
- Evidence type: press release / partner approval
- Confidence: 95% for approval; 70% for unspecified select-property use
- Confidence rationale: Agilysys and a named IHG technology executive describe InfoGenesis as an approved POS option across the portfolio, while the vendor separately says select resort hotels already use it.
- Source title: Agilysys InfoGenesis (POS) Platform Approved by IHG Hotels & Resorts Across Its Portfolio
- Source URL: https://www.agilysys.com/en/news/agilysys-infogenesis-pos-platform-approved-by-ihg-hotels-resorts-across-its-portfolio/
- Publisher or source owner: Agilysys
- Published date, if known: 2025-12-02
- Accessed date: 2026-09-22
- Exact supporting excerpt or faithful factual note: IHG approved InfoGenesis as a POS option for its hotels across brand segments; Agilysys says select resort hotels use it and describes integration with IHG property-management systems.
- Product-specific evidence: Omnichannel F&B and retail POS, mobile and self-service ordering, kiosks, KDS, mobile ordering/payment/printing, P2PE payments, QR payment, digital menu boards, room charges, and revenue posting.
- Conflicting or limiting evidence: Portfolio approval does not equal portfolio-wide deployment. No property count or named IHG deployment list is supplied.
- Recommended follow-up: Identify named IHG properties using InfoGenesis and seek IHG-controlled procurement or deployment evidence.

## Negative findings

- Candidate or claim: Agilysys has broad standalone restaurant-chain penetration comparable to restaurant-first enterprise POS vendors.
- Pages checked: All four sources in this packet.
- Result: Not established. The closest restaurant-specific evidence is one multi-concept food hall; the other evidence concerns resort, casino, or hotel-embedded F&B. This preserves the previously identified category-fit caveat.

## Source ledger

|---|---|---|---|---|
| https://www.agilysys.com/en/news/famous-foods-street-eats-in-resorts-world-las-vegas-serves-up-modern-innovative-guest-dining-through-the-agilysys-infogenesis-point-of-sale-pos-platform-and-kiosks/ | press release / customer story | 2026-09-22 | 1 | Product-rich installed food-hall deployment; casino-resort context. |
| https://www.agilysys.com/en/news/winford-resort-casino-manila-philippines-deploys-agilysys-hospitality-technology-to-elevate-operations-and-service/ | press release / testimonial | 2026-09-22 | 2 | Completed 2026 deployment across 11 resort venues. |
| https://www.agilysys.com/en/news/rudding-park-selects-agilysys-hospitality-software-solutions-to-modernise-guest-journeys-and-streamline-operations-across-its-hotel-ecosystem/ | press release | 2026-09-22 | 3 | Selected suite; planned deployment across a resort with three restaurants. |
| https://www.agilysys.com/en/news/agilysys-infogenesis-pos-platform-approved-by-ihg-hotels-resorts-across-its-portfolio/ | press release / approval | 2026-09-22 | 4 | Approved option; not portfolio-wide installed base. |

## Research notes and inferences

- Inference: Agilysys appears strongest where restaurant operations are embedded in complex hospitality properties that benefit from room-charge, loyalty, retail, casino, and property-management integration.
- Inference: The product footprint overlaps Genius in enterprise POS and payments, but these four sources do not prove that Agilysys is broadly competing for standalone restaurant-chain systems of record.
- Review boundary: Keep the observations in the research intake path until Todd decides whether hotel-, casino-, and resort-embedded F&B belongs in the canonical restaurant technology graph.
